acceptanceCriteria: unsorted --reason input is either canonicalized or refused with a code naming byte order, with a test
body: Residual from #1189. `corvint-tasks gate record --reason a --reason b` refuses when reasons are not byte-sorted; callers must pre-sort. Either canonicalize (sort+dedupe) or return a refusal that names the required order.
title: gate record --reason refuses unsorted reasons instead of canonicalizing or naming the order rule
